head -2 /tmp/results.jsonl; echo "==="; python3 -c "
import json
with open('/tmp/results.jsonl') as f:
    lines = [json.loads(l) for l in f if l.strip()]
print('total results:', len(lines))
good = sum(1 for l in lines if l.get('num_good_checks', 0) >= 1)
bad = sum(1 for l in lines if l.get('num_good_checks', 0) == 0)
print('good checks:', good, '| bad:', bad)
fmts = sorted(set(l.get('format') for l in lines))
print('formats checked:', fmts)
assert all(isinstance(l.get('http_status'), int) for l in lines)
print('JSONL VALID')
"
